optimization.baseline: Node.pose (stored ARKit/VIO odometry); app optimized graph is separately benchmarked when supplied
optimization.method: gravity-preserving 4-DoF pose graph; bidirectional trimmed point-to-point ICP loop verification
optimization.coordinate_convention: T_w_i maps node i to world; Z_i_j maps node j to i. E=inv(Z_i_j)@inv(T_w_i)@T_w_j; residual=[E.translation,SO3_log(E.rotation)]
optimization.robust_loss: block Huber delta=3 on each full-covariance-whitened 6D edge; odometry and training loops; not per-scalar Huber
optimization.covariance_model: Original full matrices retained. Odometry effective covariance = original covariance + diag(model_translation_sigma^2 x3, model_rotation_sigma^2 x3). Verified loops retain original measurement and full covariance; refined ICP transforms are not substituted.

app_saved_solution_comparison.interpretation: This candidate is experimental. Acceptance guards compare with Node.pose, not a best-map selection. Positive RMSE difference favors the saved app solution; mixed or small changes do not establish superiority. No automated selection of a universally best solution from this limited internal geometry test.

main_component_export.note: Full CSVs retain every node; isolated nodes remain exactly at their own raw pose. Main-component CSVs exclude them for map export without arbitrary correction propagation.

limitations: No independent surveyed ground truth; held-out depth geometry is an internal consistency test.
4-DoF preserves measured gravity attitude; does not repair roll/pitch bias.
No global floor-height or normal factor, preserving outdoor slopes/stairs.
No new visual loop discovery, feature RANSAC, adjacent ICP refinement, GNSS prior, TSDF or cross-session merge in this stage.
Per-edge covariance is a local tangent approximation; optional odometry model noise is a modeling assumption, not calibrated uncertainty.
With no mask directory, moving objects have not been semantically removed.
